transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me for this curriculum approval meeting. As you know, we're preparing a six-week digital reading-intervention pilot for our sixth-grade students across three middle schools. The intervention block meets three times each week, and we have two programs that have both completed our instructional-evidence review: NorthStar at $18 per student and Trail at $20 per student. Before I finalize the plan, I'd like to hear from both of you. Could the literacy coach please report any instructional requirements or considerations we should be aware of, and could the privacy liaison please share any data-governance requirements we need to address? I want to make sure we've covered all bases before I approve the program, implementation schedule, and data controls.
